title: .mutation.json
description: Optional configuration of the mutation plugin, in the service directory. Every key overrides only its own value; without the file, the defaults and what is read from the repo apply.

unitTestScript.description: The package.json script that runs the unit suite. Its jest invocation, followed through `pnpm run`/`npm run`/`yarn` references, gives the ignore patterns, setup files, environment and jest config. Default: the first of test-unit, test:unit, unit.

unitTestIgnorePatterns.description: Test paths kept out of the run (jest testPathIgnorePatterns), e.g. the integration suite. Default: the unit script's --testPathIgnorePatterns; without a unit script, /integration/ and /e2e/.

setupFilesAfterEnv.description: Added to the jest config's setupFilesAfterEnv. Relative to the service directory, or starting with <rootDir>. Default: the unit script's --setupFilesAfterEnv.

env.description: Environment for the baseline, Stryker and the rechecks. Default: the assignments in front of jest in the unit script, e.g. TZ=UTC.

ignoreCalls.description: Calls that are not mutated, with the statement that contains them. `*` stands for one name and never crosses a dot or a call; `{a,b}` is one of the names. Added to the defaults (log levels on *logger, console.*).

replaceDefaultIgnoreCalls.description: Use only ignoreCalls, without the defaults.

excludedMutations.description: Stryker mutators that do not run, e.g. StringLiteral. Default: none.

concurrency.description: Stryker test runners in parallel. Default 4; MUTATE_CONCURRENCY overrides it.

maxTestRunnerReuse.description: Mutants per test runner before it is restarted. Default 20; MUTATE_REUSE overrides it.

packageManager.description: Default: the closest lockfile up to the repo root, then the packageManager field of package.json, then npm.
